meta.description: Connect with students at Campus Oslo through BISO's Business Hotspot.

title: Business Hotspot
intro: A dedicated arena at Campus Oslo for companies to meet students through stands, talks and activities.

whatIs.label: What is Business Hotspot?
whatIs.title: A New Way to Connect with Students
whatIs.description: Business Hotspot is BISO Oslo's innovative recruitment concept - a permanent presence on campus where companies can meet and engage with students in a relaxed environment. No need for constant staffing, just meaningful connections.

featureDescriptions.0: Set up a stand or activation area to showcase your brand directly to students.
featureDescriptions.1: Host presentations, workshops, or talks to share your expertise and company culture.
featureDescriptions.2: Build lasting relationships with future talent through meaningful interactions.

whatYouCanDo.title: What You Can Do
whatYouCanDo.description: Business Hotspot offers multiple ways to engage with students and build your employer brand.

ctaSection.title: Ready to Connect with Students?
ctaSection.description: Contact us to learn more about partnership opportunities at Business Hotspot.
